chamber pot.name: chamber pot
chamber pot.description: It is a smelly, stained, ceramic chamber pot with blue and white flower designs on the outside.

brick.name: brick
brick.description: It is a crumbling, dusty old brick.

sheet.name: sheet
sheet.description: It is an odorous, soiled bedsheet that looks like it might have been white at some point.

door.name: door
door.description: It is a grimy wooden door with horizontal and vertical iron strips reinforcing it

animal bone.name: animal bone
animal bone.description: It is a short yet sturdy animal bone, possibly from some kind of rodent that died in here.

rope.name: rope
rope.description: It is a coiled length of sturdy rope. You'll probably need more than one for a safe descent.

toilet.name: toilet
toilet.description: It is a cold, wooden seat over a vertical chute, allowing waste to fall directly into the castle moat.

painting.name: painting
painting.description: It is a beautiful oil painting depicting a serene landscape with rolling hills, a calm river, and a vibrant sunset. The colors are rich and the brushstrokes are delicate, giving the scene a sense of tranquility and depth.

armor.name: armor
armor.description: They are several suits of medieval armor, complete with helmets, breastplates, gauntlets, and greaves. The metal is tarnished and dented, but it still looks sturdy enough to provide some protection.

mattress.name: mattress
mattress.description: It is a thin, lumpy mattress made of straw and covered in a threadbare cloth. It looks uncomfortable and unsanitary.
